description: This PHP class 'EndpointGetOneResult' extends 'AbstractEndpointResult' and provides a normalization method for API endpoint results, specifically for the 'Get One' endpoint in the OrangeHRM API. It appears to be part of the serialization layer for API responses within the OrangeHRM core plugin.

classes.name: EndpointGetOneResult
classes.description: A deprecated class responsible for normalizing the result of a 'Get One' API endpoint, returning the normalized object data.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the normalized representation of the result by calling normalizeObject().
